title: Quitting banking at 50 to found Nykaa
statement: Nayar left her MD role at Kotak Mahindra to start an online beauty retailer, becoming founder, operator and category missionary at an age when most executives wind down.
outcome: Nykaa built the Indian beauty market's organized retail layer, reached profitability years before e-commerce peers, and its 2021 IPO made Nayar India's wealthiest self-made female billionaire.

title: Inventory-first in a discount marketplace era
statement: Against the loss-making horizontal marketplace orthodoxy, Nykaa held beauty inventory, controlled authenticity and service, and refused to buy growth with discounts.
outcome: The model produced positive contribution margins years before its IPO, and validated that Indian vertical e-commerce could be built profitably.
